verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EKISA kya Yesu,
Kisinga-obulungi:
Kiki-ekyamutufiiriza?
Ekisa kye kingi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mu kisa neeraba
Nze nga nnina-ebibi;
Era kyennaavanga nteeka
Byonna Yesu gy'ali.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mu kisa nafuna,
-Omutima omuggya;
Kyenvudde nsaba bulijjo
-Okusiimwa Katonda.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Mukama,yongera
Okumpa-ekisa kyo;
Era nze bwe ntyo nnyongere
-Okukwagala ennyo.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.
